title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 198 Baker Street in Corning, New York, as the "Specialist Ryan P. Jayne Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 198 Baker Street in Corning, New York, as the "Specialist Ryan P. Jayne Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in Corning, New York, after Specialist Ryan P. Jayne.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 198 Baker Street in Corning, New York, as the "Specialist Ryan P. Jayne Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 8, 2014.
